subject: Trading
title: Howard Marks: The Cycle Master
description: Learn Howard Marks: The Cycle Master in one minute.

hook.text: Howard Marks doesn't predict the future. He asks one question: 'Where are we in the cycle?' That's his entire edge.

buildup.text: Marks co-founded Oaktree Capital, focusing on distressed debt—buying what others are forced to sell in panics.

discovery.text: His famous memos describe market psychology as a pendulum swinging between euphoria and despair—never at equilibrium.

twist.text: In 2008, he invested $500 million per week during the crisis. Most investors were frozen in fear; Marks was buying.

climax.text: Marks teaches that superior investing isn't about being smart—it's about understanding where consensus is wrong.

punchline.text: Know the cycle, and you'll know what to do.

quiz.question: What is Howard Marks' primary investing framework?
options: Understanding where markets are in the cycle of euphoria and despair
